current_density_result.title: Erdős's integer dilation approximation problem and GCD graphs
current_density_result.conclusion: Separation implies sum_{a<=x}1/a=o(log x), hence zero lower natural density.
current_density_result.boundary: This prior theorem does not settle the stronger reciprocal-log convergence question; no full natural-density-zero conclusion is asserted.

classical_integer_convergence.inspected_primary_attribution: Lichtman and Pomerance, Proceedings of the AMS Series B 6 (2019), 1–14, page 1 and reference [9]
classical_integer_convergence.use: The fixed-Q infinite-grid convergence corollary consumes primitive-set convergence as an established premise; no original proof replay.

mathematical_contract.prefix: Distinct a_i/Q > 1 satisfying |k a_i - a_j| >= Q for every distinct pair and every positive integer k.
mathematical_contract.larger_candidate: b > max(Q,a_i); membership exactly b mod a_i in the inclusive interval [Q,a_i-Q] for every prefix numerator.
mathematical_contract.original_questions: For an infinite countable real set A satisfying the separation condition, the formal source asks whether lower counting density is zero and whether sum_{a in A} 1/(a log a) converges.
mathematical_contract.candidate_boundary: The compiled periodic set consists of individually admissible additions to the finite prefix. Its elements need not be mutually compatible and it is not an infinite solution or counterexample.
mathematical_contract.loader_boundary: Saved-index loading checks bounded structural consistency only. It does not re-establish prefix separation, gcd/inverse/CRT arithmetic, residue completeness, source identity or the infinite conjectures.
mathematical_contract.status_correction: The formal file's open tags are not a current status census: the 2025 primary paper proves the logarithmic-density alternative and therefore the displayed lower-density consequence. Stronger general convergence is separate.
